style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, slapstick, deadpan, hard midday sun
shot: grounded low angle, camera does not move until the final push-in
character: PIG: plump pink pig, deadpan heavy-lidded eyes, blinks slowly, dusty builder's apron; trotters grip/sweep/count/pin
cast: CAT: scruffy grey tabby contractor, work vest, never speaks; large, bigger than pig
props: hammer, piggy bank, coins, blueprint pinned to a stake, cat's black debris bag with a receipt taped on — all on one wooden plank, nothing stacked
setting: yard by an unfinished house, concrete slab; a distant puddle where two small piglets lash twigs into a hut

audio.delivery: male low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry unrushed flat deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: two sentences, calm even tempo, never rushed, no pause inside either. «строительного»: stroh-EE-tyel-no-vo, stress the second syllable EE, not TYEL. Nothing after 7.95
audio.lip_sync: pig talks like a person, mouth opens/closes clearly each syllable, her own voice, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hammer strike, ceramic shattering, coins clinking, blueprint flapping, bag tearing, gravel pouring

timeline.a: silent. Hammer mid-downswing, blurred arc cutting a third of the frame; blueprint corner snapping behind her
silent. Hammer connects, bank shatters, shards and coins spray the lower frame, dust kicks up; recoil jolts her back a step
silent. Hammer drops from her grip, bounces off the plank; last coins rain down, rolling still
calm. Trotters sweep coins into a pile briskly, dust puffing, body rocking with each sweep
calm, no pause. Last sweep finishes the pile in a puff of dust, snout snaps up toward the blueprint
silent. Counts coins loud, trotter slamming each one, tail whipping; last coin gets a lighter tap, brow furrows
silent. Cat lands hard from the right, shoulder bumps hers, jolting her sideways; sets a black debris bag beside the coins
silent. Cat rips the bag open, upends it over the coins, gravel and dust spilling in
calm. Grabs the open bag, hefts it off the plank, straining
calm, no pause. Peers into the bag, snout wrinkling; cat yanks the bag hard, lurching it
calm, no pause. Trotters lock hard onto the bag's corner, gravel scraping inside
calm, no pause. Bag lifted, gravel sifting from a hole
silent. Cat's paw slams flat onto the receipt, rocking the bag, gravel spraying; paw yanks clear as she flinches back
silent. One yank rips the blueprint off the stake, slaps it over the bag hard enough to bounce, covering the receipt; the swing spins her to face camera
silent. Landing from the spin rocks her hoof to hoof, ears swinging; snout jabs hard at the gravel, pointless now
timeline.cam: only camera move in the clip: slow push-in on her face, ending the shot

must_appear: hammer shattering the piggy bank; coins piled then counted; cat landing, bumping her shoulder; bag upended over the coins, gravel mixing in; receipt taped to the bag; blueprint ripped off and slapped over the bag; the final spin to camera
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dim, moody, low key, lamp, dark scene, underexposed; extra pigs beyond the two distant piglets, extra cats; duplicate hammer, bag, blueprint, or piggy bank; floating objects; human hands; cuts, jump cuts; extra limbs; costume changes; frozen pose, motionless hold, a second driven only by a claw or ear twitch; slow speech, rushed delivery, pauses mid-sentence, speech after 7.95, foreign accent, English speech; subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, readable text
